what_it_changes: When enabled, hovering/focusing linear.app issue links in composer markdown triggers linearIssueSummaryStore.request → dashboardClient.batchGetLinearIssueSummaries and shows a hover card (title, state, assignee, project, updated time); when disabled (bundled default false), the gate short-circuits to unavailable/disabled with no RPC and the tooltip never receives summary data. Wired in both desktop and glass via checkFeatureGate in linearIssueSummaryStore.request (B5e/xNe registry).
modules: experimentConfig.gen.js (B5e/xNe), linearIssueSummaryStore.js, linear-issue-link-hover-card.react.js, ComposerMarkdownLinkContent.react.js, experimentService.js, cursorAuthenticationService (dashboardClient RPC), Linear URL parser (VNo/bal inline)
local_override: experimentService.setFeatureFlagOverride (dev builds, persisted TTL); remote Statsig gate (disableExposureLog true)
